desc: a generic Roman soothsayer (haruspex) of the 1st century BC: an old man with a grey beard, a tall pointed felt cap, a long fringed cloak whose cloth is teal over a long tunic reaching the ankles (the thigh piece and the shin piece are the same long tunic cloth), sandals; the main weapon is a curved augur staff (lituus) drawn vertically; instead of a shield draw a small bronze bowl
prompt:
Create ONE image, landscape 3:2. It is a CHARACTER PARTS SHEET for paper cut-out puppet animation. Character: a generic Roman soothsayer (haruspex) of the 1st century BC: an old man with a grey beard, a tall pointed felt cap, a long fringed cloak whose cloth is teal over a long tunic reaching the ankles (the thigh piece and the shin piece are the same long tunic cloth), sandals; the main weapon is a curved augur staff (lituus) drawn vertically; instead of a shield draw a small bronze bowl. All body parts in strict SIDE PROFILE for a character facing RIGHT, same scale across parts. Row 1, left to right: (1) HEAD in profile facing right with short neck at the bottom, wearing the headwear; (2) TORSO only, upright, side view facing right, shoulders at top and hips at bottom, no head, no arms, no legs; (3) UPPER ARM only, hanging straight down, shoulder end at top, sleeve as the costume; (4) FOREARM with closed fist, hanging straight down, elbow at top, fist at bottom. Row 2, left to right: (5) THIGH only, vertical, hip at top, knee at bottom; (6) LOWER LEG with foot or footwear, vertical, knee at top, foot at bottom pointing right; (7) the main WEAPON drawn vertically; (8) the SHIELD seen from the front (if the role has no shield, draw a quiver of arrows instead). Background: perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF everywhere, no shadows, no gradients, no texture on the background. Layout: an invisible 4 columns x 2 rows grid of equal cells; put exactly ONE item centred in each cell, fully inside its cell with wide magenta margins, items never touching. No grid lines, no labels, no text.

Art style for every asset in this library: flat hand-painted paper cut-out illustration for a history explainer animation, clean simple shapes, subtle paper grain, thin dark-brown outline, soft muted natural colours, gentle painterly shading, consistent proportions (adult figure about 7 heads tall).
Costumes are SYMBOLIC and GENERIC for the era and region: suggest the period through silhouette, headwear, garment cut and weapon type only. Do not copy any specific dynasty, uniform, museum piece or real insignia. No writing, no letters, no numbers, no real flags, no religious symbols, no real coats of arms. Emblems, if any, are simple invented geometric shapes.
Faction colour rule: every cloth part that shows which side a character fights for (main tunic or robe panel, headband, sash, cape, shield paint, banner) is painted in solid TEAL #2A8C8C. Nothing else in the image uses teal or any blue-green: skin, hair, wood, leather, metal, straw stay natural colours.
